sentences.text: Robert Franklin Palmer Jr. -LRB- June 19 , 1945 -- November 20 , 1997 -RRB- was an American writer , musicologist , clarinetist , saxophonist , and blues producer .	blues	blues	musicologist	musicologist	clarinetist	clarinetist	saxophonist	saxophonist

He is best known for his books , including Deep Blues ; his music journalism for the New York Times and Rolling Stone magazine ; his work producing blues recordings and the soundtrack of the film Deep Blues ; and his clarinet playing in the 1960s band the Insect Trust .
